summary.text: Bryce Walston is the Republican candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Denise Baum.
A miner, he named workforce development, property tax relief and public safety among his priorities in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Bryce Walston graduated from Absarokee High School and has worked as a miner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a long-time Billings resident working in Montana's mining industry and the father of three, including a daughter with special needs.

Walston said in the survey that he supports cutting red tape for small businesses, an "all-of-the-above" energy strategy, property tax relief, funding for law enforcement and reliable funding for special education programs.
He also said he signed a pledge to support congressional term limits.
